chunks.arabic_text: رِجَالُ الْكَشِّيِّ: إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِدْرِيسَ الْمُعَلِّمِ الْقُمِّيِّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ، عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ أَبَانَ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ فَضَيْلَ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ قَالَ

translations.en: Rijal al-Kashshi: Ibrahim ibn Muhammad ibn Abbas, from Ahmad ibn Idris al-Mu'allim al-Qummi, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from al-Abbas ibn Amir, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Fudhayl ibn Uthman who said:

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: إِنَّ الْأَرْضَ لَتَسْكُنُ إِلَى الْفَضْلِ بْنِ يَسَارَ

translations.en: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: Verily the Earth finds comfort in the virtue of al-Fudhayl ibn Yasar.

en.summary: This hadith from Al-Kashi’s *Rijal* highlights the unique spiritual station of al-Fudhayl ibn Yasar, a prominent companion of Imam al-Sadiq (AS), by using the metaphor of the Earth 'settling' or finding ease in his presence. This reflects the Shia concept of *al-Insan al-Kamil* (the Perfect Human), where the piety of the Imams' close associates brings tranquility to creation, mirroring the cosmic order established by divine virtue.
en.seo_question: What is the significance of al-Fudhayl ibn Yasar according to Imam al-Sadiq?

key_terms.الْفَضْلِ بْنِ يَسَارَ: al-Fudhayl ibn Yasar, a prominent companion
key_terms.تَسْكُنُ: finds comfort, rests, or is at ease
